title: Birbal and the Magic Stick
moral: Truth always comes out in the end.

scenes.summary: A merchant reports a theft to Akbar.
scenes.text: One day, a merchant came to Emperor Akbar and complained that his money had been stolen.

scenes.summary: Birbal gathers suspects and gives them sticks.
scenes.text: Birbal gathered all the suspects and gave each of them a stick, saying it was magical.

scenes.summary: The suspects take the sticks home.
scenes.text: Birbal told them that the thief’s stick would grow longer overnight, and everyone took their sticks home.

scenes.text: The thief became afraid and cut his stick shorter to avoid being caught.

story: One day, a merchant came to Emperor Akbar and said his money was stolen. Birbal gathered all suspects and gave each a stick, saying it was magical and would grow if they were guilty. The thief became afraid and cut his stick shorter. The next day, Birbal saw the shorter stick and caught the thief. The man confessed his crime.
